title: verification of the VOICE tile and system sounds on real hardware

clauses.text: A long read-aloud and a five-minute recording work with a real microphone and speakers

steps.do: With a USB microphone and speakers, READ ALOUD a long text (several pages). Then record five minutes of yourself speaking in RECORD and play it back next to the radio.
steps.expect: The long text is read through without breaks. The five-minute recording is clear, and the cue levels sound about right next to the radio.
